name: @o9qa/shell
description: The application frame: rail, header, breadcrumb, launchbar, settings, notifications and the tool chooser. Host-agnostic -- the catalogue is passed in.
_vendored: A COPY, kept in-tree so this app builds standalone. The canonical @o9qa/shell lives in its own repository and publishing belongs there. `private` is true and publishConfig is removed so this fork can never be pushed over the real package on the o9UI feed. See the repo README, 'The vendored shared layer'.
